title: Strix is a free AI that hacks your app before a real hacker does
description:
Strix: https://www.strix.ai/
Strix on GitHub: https://github.com/usestrix/strix

You shipped fast. You didn't check the doors.

Most vibe-coded apps never get tested at all.

Scanners read your code and guess.

They flag things that were never exploitable.

And they miss the ones that are.

Strix works the other way.

It runs your app and attacks it.

The way a real attacker would.

And it isn't one AI doing it.

It's a whole team going at once.

Each one hunting a different way in.

When one gets through, it shows you the path.

Exactly how it got there.

Then it writes the patch.

Like hiring a burglar to test your locks.

They tell you which window opened.

Find your holes before someone else does.

Strix is free.

#strix #cybersecurity #pentesting #aiagents #github
